scope.zh: 按中国厂家官方实时参数接口的车型代码逐列匹配。仅使用官网明确标注的年款；探歌/高尔夫未标年款，不沿用原页面2026标签。捷达保留2026款、2024款和未标年款的区分。未列轮胎尺寸、座位数及方向盘位置保持空值；选装包条件请参见厂家完整表。只摘录部分装备。 官网两条同义的外后视镜电动折叠配置行按车型合并，任一为标配则显示标配，并保留原行证据。
scope.en: Columns are matched to China-market manufacturer model codes in the live specification API. Only explicit model years are retained; T-Roc/Golf have no stated year and are not assumed to be 2026. Jetta distinguishes 2026, 2024 and unmarked entries. Unstated tyre sizes, seats and steering position remain null; option-package dependencies are in the full official table. Selected equipment only. The two synonymous power-folding-mirror rows are merged per trim; either standard row confirms fitment, and original row evidence is retained.
